facts.fact: A consultancy (Manager General Consulting) presented the Colloc-Pay platform to the Ntoum commune and the Komo-Mondah departmental council on 2026-06-19; no adoption is stated, and the platform is described as digitising and geolocating operators, digitising communal assets and enabling electronic payment of taxes.

systems.tiers: presented to Ntoum commune and Komo-Mondah department; not adopted per the article
